notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Repeat.
